constraints.label: Qubit count
constraints.summary: Peak logical width limits how much reversible state may coexist.

constraints.label: Toffoli count
constraints.summary: Nonlinear reversible operations dominate the benchmark's gate cost.

constraints.label: Spacetime product
constraints.summary: Saving qubits can require extra computation, measurement, or reconstruction.

constraints.label: Control synthesis
constraints.summary: Predicates and multi-controlled operations add reversible gate and scratch overhead.

constraints.label: Correctness
constraints.summary: Optimizations must preserve the point result, phase behavior, and ancilla contract.

constraints.label: Verifier policy
constraints.summary: The pinned evaluator and deterministic workload determine admitted observations.

constraints.label: Coefficient storage
constraints.summary: Materialized Bézout coefficients and inversion histories consume wide registers.

constraints.label: Register addressing
constraints.summary: Shared inversion storage requires reversible access to the currently active location.

constraints.label: Modular inversion
constraints.summary: Affine point addition requires a reversible inverse of the slope denominator.

constraints.label: Modular reduction
constraints.summary: Wide arithmetic results must be reduced modulo the secp256k1 prime.

constraints.label: Modular multiplication
constraints.summary: Slope and coordinate updates require reversible products without excessive gates or storage.

constraints.label: Modular addition
constraints.summary: Coordinate updates repeatedly add and subtract bounded modular values.

constraints.label: Coordinate formulae
constraints.summary: Intermediate coordinates and negations create avoidable arithmetic work.

constraints.label: Arithmetic windows
constraints.summary: Long arithmetic passes require a useful segmentation and cleanup schedule.

constraints.label: Carry propagation
constraints.summary: Carry work extends farther than the local correction actually needs.

constraints.label: Shift paths
constraints.summary: Shift-derived reduction work can be reorganized instead of replaying the same arithmetic shape.

constraints.label: Uncompute placement
constraints.summary: Cleanup boundaries determine which temporary state must remain live.

constraints.label: Phase recovery
constraints.summary: Measurement-assisted cleanup can leave a conditional phase correction.

constraints.label: Classical control
constraints.summary: Measured information must safely select later quantum operations.

constraints.label: Temporary conjunctions
constraints.summary: Short-lived logical AND values are expensive to erase coherently.

constraints.label: Construction memory
constraints.summary: Materializing a large operation stream can dominate host-side memory allocation.

constraints.label: Boundary state
constraints.summary: Boundary state can be reconstructed locally instead of staying live through the whole cleanup span.

constraints.label: Predicate lifetime
constraints.summary: A predicate is wasteful when held live across long spans with only a few consumers.

constraints.label: Reachable support
constraints.summary: Only a subset of coefficient states can actually appear during the reversible update.

constraints.label: Dead exchanges
constraints.summary: Binary-Euclidean exchanges sometimes survive after their state effect has become inert.

constraints.label: Control storage
constraints.summary: Persisting a control value can cost more than reconstructing it from existing state.

constraints.label: Dead exchanges
constraints.summary: Some lane swaps or updates become provably unnecessary under preserved invariants.

constraints.label: Width schedule
constraints.summary: Divstep state does not need the same width at every iteration.

constraints.label: Compared width
constraints.summary: The full compared width can exceed the bits that actually determine the branch.

constraints.label: Predicate reuse
constraints.summary: A comparison result becomes expensive when held live for later replay and cleanup.

constraints.label: Carry propagation
constraints.summary: Constant-addition carries traverse more lanes than the update requires.

constraints.label: Final carry
constraints.summary: The final carry can be expensive when no later step consumes it.

constraints.label: Shared controls
constraints.summary: Several nearby targets depend on the same conjunction of controls.

constraints.label: Width schedule
constraints.summary: The retained operand width should shrink as reversible inversion progresses.

constraints.label: Predicate materialization
constraints.summary: Turning a location test into a stored flag adds temporary state and cleanup.

constraints.label: Product storage
constraints.summary: Maintaining a separate product register increases live state and cleanup work.

constraints.label: Metadata storage
constraints.summary: Auxiliary state is expensive when represented as separate live registers.

constraints.label: Width schedule
constraints.summary: Live-register width can be reduced once later steps no longer depend on the full range.

constraints.label: Workspace lifetime
constraints.summary: A workspace lane should host multiple values only when their live intervals do not overlap.

constraints.label: Addition count
constraints.summary: Repeated additions dominate multiplication cost when operands are represented densely.

constraints.label: Quantum arithmetic
constraints.summary: Quantum-side arithmetic is expensive when a classical operand could be preprocessed instead.

constraints.label: Attribution
constraints.summary: Counts are misleading when phase-fixing work is hidden from the reported metric.

constraints.label: Lifetime visibility
constraints.summary: Width estimates drift when register lifetimes are inferred only implicitly.

constraints.label: Materialization cost
constraints.summary: Resource estimates drift when they count constructed auxiliaries instead of the final emitted circuit.

constraints.label: Stream neutrality
constraints.summary: A verifier-policy attempt is only meaningful if it preserves evaluator stream neutrality.

constraints.label: Artifact compatibility
constraints.summary: Validation is brittle when the emitted artifact shape is not checked against the scorer's expectations.

constraints.label: Bound coverage
constraints.summary: A verifier should prove that sampled checks cover the intended operand regime.

constraints.label: Replay fidelity
constraints.summary: A verifier is weak if it cannot faithfully replay the exact circuit behavior being scored.

constraints.label: Repeated conjunctions
constraints.summary: Several nearby targets depend on the same conjunction of controls.

constraints.label: Control values
constraints.summary: Unknown relations among controls prevent safe rewriting.

constraints.label: Gate dependencies
constraints.summary: Two matching gates are removable only if intervening operations preserve their equivalence.

constraints.label: Gate liveness
constraints.summary: Some emitted gates cannot affect any later observable state.

constraints.label: Rewrite ordering
constraints.summary: A single local rewrite can expose another one that was previously hidden.

constraints.label: Shared controls
constraints.summary: Repeatedly rebuilding the same control fanout inflates the non-Clifford network.

constraints.label: Boundary carry
constraints.summary: Carries crossing a window boundary force extra reversible work.

constraints.label: Fixed depth
constraints.summary: A reversible binary-Euclidean walk needs a sealed execution depth.

constraints.label: Product storage
constraints.summary: A reversible square needs product storage without an additional dense staging register.

constraints.label: Endpoint recovery
constraints.summary: The fixed-depth walk must recover its final modular endpoint without retaining dense state.

constraints.label: Peak overlap
constraints.summary: Walk, replay, multiplication, and square workspaces can bind the same qubit peak.

constraints.label: Replay scheduling
constraints.summary: A sequential replay keeps coefficient and ladder state live at the same time.

constraints.label: Replay work
constraints.summary: Reconstructing inverse coefficients repeats modular updates across the recorded walk.

constraints.label: Round history
constraints.summary: Inverse replay needs enough history to reconstruct every fixed-depth division step.

constraints.label: Fold masks
constraints.summary: A dense fold mask adds live storage and cleanup to pseudo-Mersenne reduction.

constraints.label: Prefix exactness
constraints.summary: Approximate boundary carries must be repaired where high prefixes determine correctness.
